titles.title: Food, Drug, Cosmetic, and Device Enforcement Amendments of 1991
Food, Drug, Cosmetic, and Device Safety Amendments of 1992
To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to enhance the enforcement authority of the Food and Drug Administration, and for other purposes.
